method: Web search in Russian, Kazakh and English ("мал базар Тараз", "рынок скота Тараз", "скотный рынок Тараз", "Тараз мал базары", "Жамбыл Ас-Ер мал базар", "Байданов/Рамазан мал базары", "Taraz livestock market"); reading of directory cards, a company registry card and the muftyat.kz list; visual inspection of eight dated YouTube video thumbnails. No photograph is redistributed with the model; thumbnails were used only as a modelling reference.
model_status: Concept model. No candidate has a confirmed official address, so the model is not a reconstruction of a particular market and carries no location.
selection_rule: A livestock market (live animals in pens and at tethering rails) is not the same as a general bazaar, a single sales point or one animal listing. A similar name alone is not a match.

Land listing «у скотного рынка — Мал базар», suburb along a highway (search snippet only; the page refused automated access).

comparison: «Ас-Ер» is the only candidate with dated photographs of a working livestock yard, but its address and operator are unconfirmed. «Байданов» and «Рамазан» have the most official mention but no address or images. «Mal Bazar Taraz» has an address but is a company, not a market. The directory entries contradict each other.
recommendation: Do not name or locate a real market in the product until one is confirmed by a visit with the owner's permission or by the city akimat/veterinary department. Build an explicitly labelled concept model from features common to the dated «Ас-Ер» photographs: open yard, steel tethering rails, mesh pens, long metal-roof sheds, perimeter fence, truck unloading area, plus a generic gate. Use no market name, brand or sign text from the references.
image_rights: Videos, thumbnails and Instagram photographs belong to their authors. They are modelling references only; nothing is copied into the repository, the GLB or the preview, and publication of any photograph needs the author's permission.

modelling_brief.priority: Gate with a generic «МАЛ БАЗАР» board, perimeter fence, long pitched metal-roof canopy over a central aisle, pens on both sides, rows of steel tethering rails, an unloading area with a ramp. A few decorative animal silhouettes, clearly not a stock count.
modelling_brief.footprint: Rectangular yard about 64 × 44 m (estimate). Gate on the +Z front, centred.
modelling_brief.materials: Earth yard (sand), white wall panels (porcelain), galvanised and painted steel (metal, ink), metal roof (stone/edge), small lime accent only on the board as a Qadam marker.
modelling_brief.scale_convention: Metres, conceptual_scale=true; no claim of a 1:1 survey.
modelling_brief.budget: Below 30,000 triangles and 1.5 MB, no textures, no Draco/Meshopt.
